data:
Yesterday and today I had follow-up appointments regarding my Port-a-Cath implantation. I completed the following:

  • Chest Radiography.
  • Echocardiogram strain.
  • Pre-operative blood tests.
  • Cardiology consultation.
  • Anesthesia consultation.

The next step is to visit the surgeon to schedule the Port-a-Cath implantation procedure. The scheduled date is January 15th.

Recently, I have been praying for wisdom and calmness. And I received them.

 My people will dwell in a peaceful abiding place, In secure dwellings and in tranquil resting-places.

— Is. 32:18
